create_concat_dataset_from_configs: create a ConcatDataset from Hydra DictConfig objects with multiple dataset splits and a sampling strategy
build_concat_dataset_with_sampling: build a ConcatDataset from a dict of datasets using explicit balanced temperature or weighted sampling ratios
get_item_from_concat_dataset: get a data sample by index from a ConcatDataset that resolves the owning sub-dataset and internal sample index
compute_cumulative_sizes_with_ratios: compute cumulative sizes for a list of datasets weighted by sample ratios using the cumsum static method
get_metadata_natoms_for_samples: get the natoms metadata for a list of sample indices across multiple concatenated datasets
